name: muon/module-api-schema-export
description: Generates HTTP client files, Postman collections, OpenAPI 3.1 and Swagger 2.0 documents for a selected set of Magento modules, resolving each REST route back to the module that declares it.

suggest.magento/module-webapi-async: Enables the /async/V1 and /async/bulk/V1 route variants in generated documents.
